expected_net_EV.note: Computed CONSERVATIVELY at the worst-case fill (zone high 4342.4, d = 1.372pt ABOVE the level 4341.028). Measured cell s6.0_t12: grossR +0.4631 in units of the family's 6.0pt risk = +2.7786pt per trade relative to an entry AT the level. The stop and target are FIXED prices (4335.3 / 4353.3) and the fill shift is exact, so a fill d above the level moves the whole outcome distribution down by d points and widens the risk to (6.0 + d): (2.7786 - 1.372) / 7.372 = +0.1908R, minus the 0.56pt cost (0.076R) = +0.115R point. FLOOR at the cell's CI-low grossR +0.4258 (2.5548pt): (2.5548 - 1.372) / 7.372 = +0.1604R - 0.076R = +0.085R. BOTH POSITIVE -> LONG authorised; the reported value is the conservative worst-fill floor, +0.085R. Measured against the plan's own 7.10pt risk the same two reads are +0.119R / +0.088R, i.e. marginally better; the family-geometry figure is reported to stay comparable with the sibling plans. I deliberately do NOT use the binary p x R - (1-p) formula (0.5618 x 2.0 - 0.4382 = +0.685R) because the measured family includes time-out partials and that formula overstates. Sensitivity upward, not downward: zone-mid fill (4341.2, d 0.172) -> +0.422R gross, +0.331R net; zone-low fill (4340.0, d -1.028) -> +0.556R net. Even a crude 25% haircut on the mean outcome (2.7786pt -> 2.084pt) at the worst-case fill still leaves (2.084 - 1.372) / 7.372 = +0.0966R - 0.076R = +0.021R, positive.
